claims.summary: The dialogue runtime scans exact known control markers, classifies declared reference syntax, and reconstructs a visible remainder.
claims.disposition: Verified from the report-bound source and the complete same-SHA source read from the immediately preceding stewardship round.

claims.summary: first_word_after returns an empty string when no alphanumeric or underscore-bearing word follows a marker.
claims.disposition: Verified directly from source and by exact assertions for punctuation-only and whitespace-only suffixes.

claims.summary: An empty later word might make marker handling fragile or incorrectly erase surrounding output.
claims.disposition: Implemented an exact fail-closed regression: only the known marker is removed, punctuation or newline remains byte-exact, and the receipt names none_cleanup_candidate.

claims.summary: A known marker followed by the declared relation behaves should remain visible.
claims.disposition: Verified from the finite source allowlist and passing exact relation regressions, including the adjacent colon-separated behaves case.

claims.summary: Nested exact-reference delimiters should report depth relative to MAX_EXACT_REFERENCE_DELIMITER_DEPTH.
claims.disposition: Verified by source and passing two-, three-, four-, repeated-pair, Unicode-whitespace, and deeper-stack tests; evidence depth caps at four without dropping the marker.
